questions.stem: Which measured segment had the shortest mean length in Table 2 of the 35-cadaver study Segmental colonic length and mobility by Phillips and colleagues?
questions.solutionHtml:
Correct answer: B - Ascending colon plus caecum

B is correct for this study: the mean lengths were ascending colon plus caecum 20.9 cm, transverse colon 50.2 cm, descending colon 21.8 cm and rectosigmoid 38.3 cm. The study examined 35 fixed cadavers, and its segment definitions matter: ascending length included the caecum and rectosigmoid included the intraperitoneal rectal portion. These are study means, not a universal ordering in every patient. The imported explanation labeled A but named ascending colon. This editorial clarification replaces the underspecified shortest-segment claim with an explicitly sourced comparison.

Editorial reconstruction/clarification: imported wording/options were revised for a source-backed single-best-answer question. This is not recovered original examination wording. The original record is retained in the review backup.
